name: Vadna (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of yellow and blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vadna: a white shield with a yellow unicorn and a sabre, within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed VADNA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
